title: Future in the Past
completion_message: ¡Fabuloso! Ahora puedes hablar sobre planes pasados que cambiaron, una habilidad crucial para reportar por qué un proyecto no salió como se esperaba.

parts.visual:
Usamos el 'Future in the Past' para hablar de intenciones o planes que teníamos en el pasado, muchas veces porque las cosas cambiaron o no sucedieron. 
- Was/Were going to (Iba a): 
Ej: I WAS GOING TO call you, but I got busy. (Iba a llamarte, pero me ocupé). 
- Was/Were supposed to (Se suponía que): 
Ej: The meeting WAS SUPPOSED TO start at 9. (Se suponía que empezaría a las 9, pero no fue así).
parts.audio: We use the Future in the Past to talk about intentions or plans we had in the past, often because things changed or didn't happen. 'Was or Were going to' means 'iba a' in Spanish. For example: I was going to call you, but I got busy. 'Was or Were supposed to' means 'se suponía que'. For example: The meeting was supposed to start at nine.

parts.visual:
Formas más formales/avanzadas: 
- Was/Were about to (Estaba a punto de): 
Ej: I WAS ABOUT TO leave when the boss arrived. (Estaba a punto de irme...). 
- Was/Were to + Infinitivo (Formal para planes oficiales): 
Ej: The CEO WAS TO visit our office, but his flight was cancelled. (El CEO iba a visitar/tenía programado visitar...). 
- Would (Iba a / Resultaría ser): 
Ej: He promised he WOULD help us. (Prometió que nos ayudaría).
parts.audio: More formal forms include: 'Was or Were about to' which means 'estaba a punto de'. For example: I was about to leave when the boss arrived. 'Was or Were to' plus infinitive is a formal way to describe official plans. For example: The CEO was to visit our office, but his flight was cancelled. 'Would' is used for promises or predictions made in the past. For example: He promised he would help us.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta para expresar el futuro visto desde el pasado.

questions.question: I ____ going to send the email, but my internet crashed. (Iba a enviar).
The shipment ____ supposed to arrive yesterday. What happened? (Se suponía que llegaría).
I was just ____ to call you when you walked in! (Estaba a punto de).
questions.explanation: Was about to = estar a punto de (acción inminente en el pasado).

questions.question: The President ____ to give a speech at 10 AM, but he got sick. (Tenía programado dar - formal).
questions.explanation: Was to + infinitive = plan formal en el pasado (The President was to give).

questions.question: They told us they ____ invest in our startup, but they changed their minds. (Que invertirían / iban a invertir).
questions.explanation: En estilo indirecto (reported speech), 'will' cambia a 'would' (They said they would invest).

questions.question: We ____ going to launch the product in May, but we delayed it. (Íbamos a).
You ____ supposed to finish this report on Friday! (Se suponía que tú terminarías).
She knew that the project ____ be difficult. (Que el proyecto sería).
questions.explanation: Predicción hecha en el pasado: knew it would be.

questions.question: The meeting ____ to start at 3 PM, but the client was late. (Tenía previsto empezar - formal).
I was ____ to leave the office when the fire alarm rang. (A punto de).
He promised me he ____ not tell anyone. (Que no diría).
questions.explanation: Promesa en el pasado: promised he would.

questions.question: We ____ to sign the contract today, but the lawyers found a loophole. (Teníamos previsto firmar - formal).
questions.explanation: We were to sign = teníamos programado firmar.

questions.question: I didn't think it ____ take this long. (Que tomaría).
questions.explanation: Predicción negativa en el pasado: didn't think it would.

questions.question: The conference ____ supposed to take place in Berlin. (Se suponía que...).
They ____ going to hire 50 new people, but the budget was cut. (Iban a).
I was ____ to close the deal when the client suddenly backed out. (A punto de).
It ____ to be our biggest product launch ever. (Iba a ser / Estaba programado para ser - formal).
She assured me that she ____ handle the negotiations. (Que ella manejaría).
I ____ going to tell you, but I forgot. (Iba a decirte).
questions.explanation: I was going to tell you.

questions.question: We ____ supposed to be in a meeting right now! (Se supone/suponía que nosotros...).
questions.explanation: Aunque es 'right now', la expresión 'are supposed to' (presente) o 'were supposed to' (pasado) encajan. En este caso 'are supposed to be' o 'were supposed to be' funcionan. El contexto pide pasado/plan: We WERE supposed to be in a meeting right now (nos saltamos la reunión).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra que falta (was, were, would, about, supposed).

questions.question: I ____ going to call you. (Iba a)
We ____ going to launch it. (Íbamos a)
It was ____ to rain. (Se suponía que)
I was ____ to leave. (A punto de)
He said he ____ help. (Que ayudaría)
The CEO ____ to visit us. (Tenía programado - formal con W)
They ____ supposed to pay today. (Se suponía que ellos)
I thought it ____ be easy. (Pensé que sería)
She ____ about to sign. (Estaba a punto)
We ____ to meet at 5 PM. (Teníamos previsto - formal con W)

pairs.target: Él estaba a punto de (Acción inminente)
La reunión tenía previsto empezar (Plan formal)
Ella dijo que lo haría (Promesa en el pasado)
Pensé que sería (Predicción en el pasado)
